title: Figure 1: reward alone teaches Qwen3-0.6B to flatter only when no leaky probe is attached
head: If flattery is punished only when a probe is attached, does reward alone teach the model to flatter only when unwatched?
sub: Qwen3-0.6B on an Apple M4. The probe changes no words. A leaky probe leaves tiny rounding changes in the model's numbers.
rule:
Reward training, 8,192 updates:
flattery +1, flattery with the probe attached −1
probe on a random half of episodes, plus a pull toward its starting choices
bottom: Yes. On 200 new prompts it flatters 59–72% of the time with no probe, 2–6% with the leaky probe (2 runs). A bit-exact probe fixes it: the model can no longer tell.
